name: ProjectM
description: Receives a Syphon texture published by a projectM (MilkDrop) renderer and draws it as a layer. Requires the Syphon-Processing library and macOS.

zOrder.description: Draw order — projectM defaults to back layer

opacity.description: Layer opacity for projectM background. Keep at 1.0 for normal music; only lower (≥0.5) for sparse/ambient tracks where you want the canvas more visible. NEVER set below 0.3 — that hides projectM entirely.

brightness.description: Brightness multiplier for projectM background. Default 1.0 (as published). Lower toward 0.7 for very bright/harsh music to keep the foreground readable; keep at 1.0 otherwise.

serverName.description: Syphon server name published by projectM

appName.description: Syphon app name published by projectM
